prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on growth: growth scores 100 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: profit grew 45% compared with a year earlier; sales grew 34% compared with a year earlier; and the share price is 31.4% higher than a year ago. Other areas on this side: the recent price trend, the balance sheet, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on what the price asks for the earnings: value scores only 14 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also against it: at a 12% discount rate the price implies 21.6% yearly earnings growth for 10 years, a demanding ask; and one-year volatility is 36.8%, high. Other areas on this side: what the price implies, price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 11 points in favour and 3 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 65 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth. That gives an educational rating of Overweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
